name: MateHunter 19 king-danger
source: https://github.com/ScottMoore0/matehunter at tag v0.1.0, whose search this development build reproduces (REFERENCE.md)
notes: The full king-danger evaluator in REFERENCE.md: MateEval on, MateEvalNull off, MateMode off, every other mate option set off explicitly. Same binary as matehunter-19.json. Tuned on matetrack.

build.make: cd src && patch -p1 < matehunter.patch && make -j build ARCH=<arch>
build.measured: a development build (g++ 13.3.0, ARCH=x86-64-avx512icl); Stockfish 19 plus the public patch, built with ARCH=x86-64-avx2, gives the same bench under this manifest's options and identical node-budget searches (engines/README.md)
